title: Monster X/Day and innate per-day uses must regain on a long rest, not at dawn (SRD p.259)
description: Pre-existing SRD contradiction reported by re-audit R2 outside its bounded scope (eshyra-o9bd.19.6.7.15), verified by Captain at origin/main. SRD p.259 rule:limited-usage: 'X/Day. The notation "X/Day" means a special ability can be used X number of times and that a monster must finish a long rest to regain expended uses.' packages/core/src/state/usageCounters.ts header says 'X/Day means X uses, regained at dawn (limited-usage)' and assigns resetKind 'dawn' to creature usage.perDay (~l.375-381) and innate per-day spell groups (~l.492-515). Repro: Aboleth Enslave (3/Day) stays spent after a long-rest reset and returns on a dawn reset (/tmp/a2-reaudit/probes/p40-xday.mts). Blocker under the standing SRD-fidelity rule. Scope: creature/monster per-day economies only; magic-item 'regains at dawn' economies are printed as dawn and stay dawn; character features follow their own printed text.
design: 2026-11-06 DESIGN (Captain): set resetKind for creature usage.perDay and innate per-day spell groups to long_rest (and make sure the long_rest reset event covers them, scoped to the owning monster/actor as reset_usage long_rest already scopes); fix the header comment; check every consumer of the 'dawn' reset for creature counters (reset tables at ~l.232-242, reset_usage, advance_time dawn processing, protocol and tool texts that say per-day monster uses reset at dawn) and update them truthfully, including the capability inventory entries for the usage tools; additive migration only if persisted reset kinds of existing counters must be corrected (check how resetKind is stored and whether it is re-derived from the record). Tests: Aboleth Enslave regains on a long-rest reset and not on a dawn reset; an innate per-day group likewise; a magic-item dawn economy still regains at dawn. Check rule:limited-usage text in records.json. Implementer: Claude Haiku 5.5.
acceptance_criteria:
- Monster X/Day and innate per-day uses regain only on a long rest, as SRD p.259 prints; magic-item dawn economies are unchanged.
- Comments, tool descriptions, protocol text and capability inventory state this truthfully; existing campaigns' counters are handled correctly.
- Regression evidence for a creature X/Day ability, an innate per-day group, and an unchanged item dawn economy.
notes: Captain: integrated .20.1 (3d49e973) after own review (no creature prints a dawn recovery, so migration 0055's combatant-dawn selection is safe) and own verify (exit 0).
